# Support

## Community Support

- Open a discussion or issue for questions and troubleshooting
- Use the project Discord for real-time discussion (see README links)

## Bug Reports

Please open a GitHub issue and include:

- What you expected to happen
- What actually happened
- Steps to reproduce
- Environment details (OS, browser, Node version)

## Feature Requests

Open a GitHub issue describing the use case and expected behavior.

## Security Issues

For security vulnerabilities, follow the private disclosure process described in `SECURITY.md`.
